entries.claimSummaryRu: CABA signal/command hierarchy puts authority orders first, then circumstantial/transitory signaling, traffic lights, vertical signs/markings, and general legal norms.
entries.notes: Supports b-fallback-311 and compact priority-hierarchy prose; exact image option C remains ticket-specific.

entries.claimSummaryRu: At unsignalized CABA intersections, avenue/street/passage hierarchy precedes right-side priority for equal hierarchy, with listed exceptions.
entries.notes: Supports b-fallback-053, 116, 264 and 281 generalized priority reasoning; exact vehicle-letter mapping remains image-specific.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Vehicles must not enter an intersection or pedestrian crossing, even with priority, if traffic could stop them and obstruct cross traffic.
entries.notes: Supports b-fallback-312 and the do-not-block-intersection trap note.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Anexo L sign entries support PARE, CEDA EL PASO, PREFERENCIA DE AVANCE, Incorporación de tránsito lateral, Encrucijada and Calzada resbaladiza meanings used in assigned tickets.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Current archived rules support the assigned mixed-ticket boundaries for overpassing near continuous lines/dangerous places, turns, reverse movement and lane-change priority.
relevantSections: Ley 2148 6.1.19 Precauciones al circular marcha atrás
entries.notes: Used only to keep b-fallback-043, 118, 148, 150, 164, 165, 171 and 244 explanations within their mixed-ticket boundaries; overtaking-and-passing placements for 118/150/171 remain planned.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Ley 2148 and Ley 24.449 support the general left-side overtaking rule with Ley 2148 right-side exceptions, visibility/free-space checks, no maneuver near intersections/curves/bridges/level crossings/dangerous places, and safe right-lane return.
entries.notes: Supports generalized safe-passing/prohibited-place prose and tickets b-fallback-118, 171, 179, 207, 261, 331, 333, and 411. Ley 2148 right-side exceptions are mentioned only to qualify the source-backed left-side rule; assigned ticket explanations do not generalize beyond their prompts. Exact image/vehicle-letter mappings stay ticket-specific.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Ley 2148 and Anexo L support left/overtaking-lane use, staying in lane except for sobrepaso, R.6 no adelantar, R.10 no lane change, and continuous/discontinuous line meanings.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Ley 2148 limits horn use to potentially dangerous situations when other signals are impossible or insufficient, while overtake intent is warned with light flashes and turn indicators; Ley 24.449 permits horn wording in rural overtake context.
entries.notes: Supports b-fallback-099 and keeps the learning material from treating bocina as a generic urban passing signal.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Ley 2148 prohibits same-direction passing in temporary narrowing/work-zone sections and requires the following vehicle to continue behind the vehicle ahead.
relevantSections: Ley 2148 6.1.16 Circulación en tramos de arterias con estrechamientos temporarios
Anexo L Dispositivos transitorios including conos/delineadores
entries.notes: Supports temporary narrowing / orange-device reasoning for b-fallback-291 without generalizing the exact line-imaginaria image answer beyond the ticket.

entries.claimSummaryRu: CABA requires drivers to maintain psychophysical conditions for vehicle control and prohibits driving after substances that reduce aptitude; reduced aptitude includes fatigue, attention, perception, coordination and judgment effects.
entries.notes: Supports only the general impairment/aptitude framing. Beer reaction, resaca, one-hour alcohol curve, vision effects, sedating-medication wording and 17-hours-awake comparison remain ticket-specific unless separately archived official support is added.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Ley 2148 CABA thresholds for assigned fallback tickets: 0.5 g/L ordinary drivers, 0.2 g/L motovehicles, 0.0 g/L passenger/minor/cargo transport and beginner drivers; beginner-driver condition lasts two years.
relevantSections: Ley 2148 5.4.4 Niveles de alcohol en sangre para conductores
entries.notes: Ley 2148 supports the CABA thresholds expected by b-fallback-117, 203 and 446. The current archived Ley 24.449 has stricter national cero-alcohol wording, so this slice does not generalize the old fallback 0.5 answer outside CABA/fallback-ticket context.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Drivers must submit to alcohol/toxicological controls; refusal constitutes a fault/presumed positive state, and CABA procedure prohibits continued driving and orders vehicle removal for over-limit alcohol or refusal.
relevantSections: Ley 2148 5.4.3 Obligación de la autoridad de control

Ley 2148 5.4.7 Procedimiento para casos de control de alcoholemia positivo
Ley 2148 5.4.8 Presencia de otras sustancias que disminuyen la aptitud para conducir
entries.notes: Supports b-fallback-044 and b-fallback-270 refusal/control consequences. Authorities-controls-and-sanctions overlap remains planned for its own slice.
